titel: Agents: set up the folder, rename, start
kurz: An agent works in a folder on this PC. So that the AMW can notify it, monitor it and show its usage, the AMW sets up this folder once.
brauchst: The folder the agent works in (usually the project folder).
The command line on the PC (`amw …`).

schritte.text: Run `amw einrichten agenten-ordner <folder> --projekt <project>`. The AMW adds its entries to the Claude Code settings in this folder and backs up the file first. After that, the agent's “State and usage” appears.
Settings › Agents shows folder, model, effort, permissions and first prompt. Change them there or with `amw agent profil <name> --ordner … --modell …`.
On the home page click the agent › “Start / resume”. The AMW opens it in a new terminal tab.

werte: the project folder the agent works in
first sentence of a new session, e.g. “Read your messages and work through them.”
fehler: “No data yet” under State and usage
The folder is not set up yet (step 1), or the session was started before the setup. Restart it once.
The session is running but does not know its name. In the agent's window run `amw anmelden --von <name>`.
“… is logged in to another session”

A second Claude window uses the name of an agent that is already running in another window. The AMW does not accept commands under that name from there. Only if this really is the right agent: `amw anmelden --von <name> --ersetzen`.
The folder already belongs to another project
A folder belongs to exactly one project. Use a separate folder for a second project.
danach: Rename: `amw agent umbenennen <old> <new>`. The old name stays valid as a second name, so older messages and commands keep working.
`amw einrichten agenten-ordner <folder> --entfernen` removes what the AMW added to the folder.
fragen: Why can't I rename in the Workbench?
The name is used in start scripts and running sessions on this PC. The command line changes everything in one place without a running session losing its name.
How do I start an agent by hand – for example after restarting the PC?

⋯ on the agent › “Start command …” (or Settings › Agents › “Start command to copy”). It lists folder, extra folders, model, effort, permissions and the last session, followed by two ready lines: “Resume” (last session) and “Start fresh” – for PowerShell or the command prompt. “Copy”, paste into a terminal, Enter. This is exactly how AMW starts the agent itself.
How much does an agent use per task?

Click the agent › Overview › “Usage per task”: the median of the last ten finished tasks, the model and effort that are set, the task in progress so far and the amount for each task. A task's window shows its value under “Usage”; on the command line see `amw aufgabe zeige <nr>` and `amw agent profil <name>`. It counts the dollar equivalent Claude Code reports per session – also on a subscription, where nothing is paid extra. Per task it is approximated: what was used between start and finish counts towards the task the agent started last. The numbers help when setting model and effort in the profile; they apply from the next start.
What do the agents spend their money on?

Operations › “Where the money goes” (on the PC) or `amw verbrauch pareto --tage 7`: each cost increase of a session belongs to the wake-ups in the same period – such as “Run is due”, review request, answer, order –; without a wake-up it counts as own work. The most expensive comes first, with share, number of wake-ups and cost per wake-up. “Avoidable” means the agent did not have to do anything for it. This shows which wake-ups are most worth switching off.
Which model and effort does AMW recommend?

When creating a task, the lead gives it a size and a type: `amw aufgabe neu … --groesse S|M|L|XL --art text|mechanisch|fehlersuche|oberflaeche|sicherheit|konzept` (later with `amw aufgabe aendern <nr>`). From that AMW suggests model and effort – using a table per project (Settings › Project › “Recommended model · effort”). The starting values are an assumption; next to the suggestion on the task you see what finished tasks of the same type and size actually used and how often their review was red. Use that to adjust the table. The agent shows the recommendation from its recent tasks; “Apply to profile” sets it. AMW changes nothing by itself and restarts no one: the profile applies from the next start.
